quote: When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小训练集上训练时，通常在留出测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1]。

quote: If the relationship between the input and the correct output is complicated and the network has enough hidden units to model it accurately, there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly, especially if there is only a limited amount of labeled training data.
claim: 原文指出，如果输入与正确输出之间的关系复杂且网络有足够多的隐藏单元来精确建模，通常会有许多不同的权重设置能几乎完美地建模训练集，尤其是当标注训练数据有限时 [p2]。

quote: If the relationship between the input and the correct output is complicated and the network has enough hidden units to model it accurately, there will typically be many different settings of the weights that can model the training set almost perfectly, especially if there is only a limited amount of labeled training data.
claim: 这些权重向量在留出测试数据上会做出不同预测，且几乎都会比在训练数据上表现更差，因为特征检测器被调谐为在训练数据上协同工作，而非在测试数据上 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出用 dropout 来防止训练数据上的复杂共适应：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以 0.5 的概率被随机从网络中省略，因此隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: dropout 也可视为一种对神经网络进行模型平均的高效方式，它使得在合理时间内训练大量不同网络成为可能，这些网络共享被保留隐藏单元的相同权重 [p3]。

quote: We use the standard, stochastic gradient descent procedure for training the dropout neural networks on mini-batches of training cases, but we modify the penalty term that is normally used to prevent the weights from growing too large.
claim: 训练采用标准随机梯度下降，但修改了惩罚项：不再惩罚整个权重向量的平方长度，而是对每个隐藏单元的输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束，则通过除法重新归一化该隐藏单元的权重 [p4]。

quote: It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
claim: 在 MNIST 上，使用 60,000 张 28x28 训练图像和 10,000 张测试图像，对隐藏单元使用 50% dropout 并对每个隐藏单元的输入权重施加单独的 L2 约束，将标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果从 160 个错误降至约 130 个错误，再对随机 20% 的像素也进行 dropout 后进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: The input to the net is 21 adjacent frames with an advance of 10ms per frame.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，输入为 21 个相邻帧、每帧前进 10ms，网络有 4 个全连接隐藏层、每层 4000 个单元和 185 个 softmax 输出单元，50% 隐藏单元 dropout 显著改善分类 [p9]。

quote: This left us with 50 classes and 402,738 documents.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，使用 50 个类别、402,738 篇文档，每篇文档用 2000 个最频繁非停用词表示，训练了 2000-2000-1000-50 架构的网络 [A3.p2][A3.p3]。

quote: We used a 2000-2000-1000-50 architecture.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，使用 50 个类别、402,738 篇文档，每篇文档用 2000 个最频繁非停用词表示，训练了 2000-2000-1000-50 架构的网络 [A3.p2][A3.p3]。

quote: Our models for CIFAR-10 and ImageNet are deep, feed-forward convolutional neural networks (CNNs).
claim: 此外还在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 上使用深度前馈卷积神经网络进行实验 [A6.p1][A8.p3]。

quote: What we wanted to demonstrate is that dropout is a significant help even for the very complex neural nets that have been developed by the joint efforts of many groups over many years to be really good at object recognition.
claim: 此外还在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet 上使用深度前馈卷积神经网络进行实验 [A6.p1][A8.p3]。

quote: This can be reduced to about 130 errors by using 50% dropout with separate L2 constraints on the incoming weights of each hidden unit and further reduced to about 110 errors by also dropping out a random 20% of the pixels (see figure 1).
claim: 在 MNIST 上，50% dropout 配合每个隐藏单元输入权重的单独 L2 约束将标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果从 160 个错误降至约 130 个错误，再对随机 20% 像素 dropout 后进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，无 dropout 时识别率为 22.7%，有 dropout 时改善至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法的纪录 [p9]。

quote: As in all previous datasets discussed so far, we obtain significant improvements here too.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，dropout 同样带来显著改进，学习不仅产生更好的泛化，而且进展平滑，无需早停 [A3.p4]。

quote: The features that dropout learns are simpler and look like strokes, whereas the ones learned by standard backpropagation are difficult to interpret.
claim: 在特征层面，dropout 学到的特征更简单、看起来像笔画，而标准反向传播学到的特征难以解释，这证实 dropout 迫使判别模型学习更少共适应的好特征并带来更好泛化 [A1.SS3.p1]。

quote: The degradation (of training accuracy) indicates that not all systems are similarly easy to optimize.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：随着网络加深，训练精度反而下降（退化问题），而这不是由梯度消失/爆炸造成的 [S1.p4]。

quote: The degradation (of training accuracy) indicates that not all systems are similarly easy to optimize.
claim: 作者指出，按构造存在一个更深的模型其训练误差不应高于较浅对应模型，但现有求解器无法找到与构造解相当或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架：不要求每几个堆叠层直接拟合目标映射 H(x)，而是让这些层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原映射改写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 作者假设优化残差映射比优化原始无参照映射更容易 [S1.p5]。

quote: The shortcut connections in Eqn.( 1) introduce neither extra parameter nor computation complexity.
claim: 捷径连接不引入额外参数或计算复杂度，因此可以在参数、深度、宽度和计算开销相同的条件下公平比较普通网络与残差网络 [S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 作者在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: We adopt batch normalization (BN) right after each convolution and before activation
claim: 训练采用随机尺度增强、224×224 裁剪、逐像素均值减法、标准颜色增强、每个卷积后激活前使用 BN，SGD 小批量 256，学习率从 0.1 开始，误差平台时除以 10，最多训练 60×10^4 次迭代，权重衰减 0.0001，动量 0.9，不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
claim: 此外在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上研究极深网络行为，使用简单架构、权重衰减 0.0001、动量 0.9、BN、无 dropout，小批量 128，学习率 0.1 并在 32k 和 48k 迭代时除以 10，64k 迭代终止 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: These models are trained with a mini-batch size of 128 on two GPUs.
claim: 此外在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上研究极深网络行为，使用简单架构、权重衰减 0.0001、动量 0.9、BN、无 dropout，小批量 128，学习率 0.1 并在 32k 和 48k 迭代时除以 10，64k 迭代终止 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
claim: 还在 PASCAL VOC 2007/2012 和 MS COCO 上以 Faster R-CNN 做目标检测，比较用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 的改进 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%)
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 训练误差明显更低并能泛化到验证数据，表明退化问题在此设置下得到解决 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
claim: 与对应的普通网络相比，34 层 ResNet 将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，优于此前所有集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote: our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，ResNet 同样克服优化困难并随深度增加获得精度提升 [S4.SS2.p5]；

quote: this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1%
claim: 1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差 7.93%，但测试结果差于 110 层网络，作者认为原因是过拟合 [S4.SS2.p8][S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error. We argue that this is because of overfitting.
claim: 1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差 7.93%，但测试结果差于 110 层网络，作者认为原因是过拟合 [S4.SS2.p8][S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement
claim: 在目标检测上，ResNet-101 在 COCO 标准指标 mAP@[.5,.95] 上比 VGG-16 提升 6.0%，相对提升 28% [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
claim: 作者承认，1202 层网络测试结果差于 110 层网络，认为原因是过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大，本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
claim: 作者还指出，深层普通网络优化困难的原因尚不清楚，将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: we have not performed multi-scale training because of limited time
claim: 此外，多尺度训练因时间有限未进行，多尺度测试也仅用于 Fast R-CNN 步骤而未用于 RPN 步骤 [A2.p5]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
claim: 注意力机制已成为序列建模与转换模型的重要组成部分，但除少数情况外，这类注意力机制都与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output
claim: 因此本文提出 Transformer，完全依赖注意力机制来建立输入与输出之间的全局依赖，不再使用循环 [S1.p4]。

quote: The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder
claim: Transformer 在编码器和解码器中都使用堆叠的自注意力层与逐位置全连接层 [S3.p2]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 其注意力采用缩放点积注意力：计算查询与所有键的点积，各自除以根号 d_k，再经 softmax 得到对值的权重 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
claim: 模型使用 8 个并行注意力头，每个头取 d_k=d_v=d_model/h=64，因此总计算成本与全维度的单头注意力相近 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote: The Transformer uses multi-head attention in three different ways
claim: 多头注意力在模型中有三种用法：编码器-解码器注意力、编码器自注意力，以及带掩码以保持自回归性质的解码器自注意力 [S3.SS2.SSS3.p1]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 训练使用标准的 WMT 2014 英德数据集，约 450 万句对，采用字节对编码、共享源目标词表约 37000 个 token；英法使用更大的 WMT 2014 英法数据集，共 3600 万句，词表为 32000 个 word-piece [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: During training, we employed label smoothing of value $\epsilon_{ls}=0.1$.
claim: 训练时使用值为 0.1 的标签平滑，这会损害困惑度，但提升准确率和 BLEU [S5.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: we varied our base model in different ways, measuring the change in performance on English-to-German translation on the development set, newstest2013
claim: 作者还在英德开发集 newstest2013 上对基础模型做多种变体以评估各组件的重要性 [S6.SS2.p1]，并在英语成分句法分析任务上做了少量实验以检验泛化能力 [S6.SS3.p1][S6.SS3.p3]。

quote: To evaluate if the Transformer can generalize to other tasks we performed experiments on English constituency parsing.
claim: 作者还在英德开发集 newstest2013 上对基础模型做多种变体以评估各组件的重要性 [S6.SS2.p1]，并在英语成分句法分析任务上做了少量实验以检验泛化能力 [S6.SS3.p1][S6.SS3.p3]。

quote: We performed only a small number of experiments to select the dropout, both attention and residual (section 5.4), learning rates and beam size on the Section 22 development set
claim: 作者还在英德开发集 newstest2013 上对基础模型做多种变体以评估各组件的重要性 [S6.SS2.p1]，并在英语成分句法分析任务上做了少量实验以检验泛化能力 [S6.SS3.p1][S6.SS3.p3]。

quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，模型取得 28.4 BLEU，超过此前最佳结果（包括集成模型）2 BLEU 以上 [abstract]。

quote: On the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task, our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models, at less than $1/4$ the training cost of the previous state-of-the-art model.
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英法任务上，大模型取得 41.0 BLEU，优于所有此前发表的单模型，训练成本不到此前最优模型的四分之一 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: Our results in Table 4 show that despite the lack of task-specific tuning our model performs surprisingly well, yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar.
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，尽管缺少任务特定调参，模型表现仍出人意料地好，优于此前报告的所有模型，但 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar 除外 [S6.SS3.p4]。

quote: We also experimented with using learned positional embeddings instead, and found that the two versions produced nearly identical results
claim: 作者还发现，使用学习到的位置嵌入与正弦位置编码两种版本结果几乎相同，选择正弦版本是因为它可能允许模型外推到比训练时更长的序列长度 [S3.SS5.p5]。

quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
claim: 自注意力将任意两个位置连接所需的操作数降为常数，但代价是有效分辨率降低，因为注意力加权位置被平均，作者用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制为只考虑以相应输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该方法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
claim: 作者还表示计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限的注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频和视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务专用架构，且难以提供决策来源和更新世界知识 [abstract]。

quote: Here, we bring hybrid parametric and non-parametric memory to the “workhorse of NLP,” i.e. sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models.
claim: 作者希望将参数与非参数记忆的混合模型从抽取式任务扩展到序列到序列生成模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: The retriever (Dense Passage Retriever, henceforth DPR) provides latent documents conditioned on the input, and the seq2seq model (BART) then conditions on these latent documents together with the input to generate the output.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（DPR）和生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1})（BART），将检索文档视为隐变量并端到端训练 [S1.p2][S2.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: 模型包含检索器 p_η(z|x)（DPR）和生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1})（BART），将检索文档视为隐变量并端到端训练 [S1.p2][S2.p1]。

quote: In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document to predict each target token.
claim: 作者提出两种边缘化方式：RAG-Sequence 对每个目标 token 使用同一文档，RAG-Token 可对每个 token 使用不同文档 [S2.p2]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 所有实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump 作为非参数知识源，每篇文章切分为 100 词块，共 2100 万文档，用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 训练时检索 top k 文档，k∈{5,10}，测试时 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。

quote: We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
claim: 评估任务包括四个开放域问答数据集（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）[S3.SS1.p1]、MSMARCO 抽象问答 [S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 以及 FEVER 事实验证 [S1.p4]。

quote: To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
claim: 评估任务包括四个开放域问答数据集（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）[S3.SS1.p1]、MSMARCO 抽象问答 [S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 以及 FEVER 事实验证 [S1.p4]。

quote: To evaluate RAG’s generation abilities in a non-QA setting, we study open-domain question generation.
claim: 评估任务包括四个开放域问答数据集（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）[S3.SS1.p1]、MSMARCO 抽象问答 [S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 以及 FEVER 事实验证 [S1.p4]。

quote: For FEVER fact verification, we achieve results within 4.3% of state-of-the-art pipeline models which use strong retrieval supervision.
claim: 评估任务包括四个开放域问答数据集（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）[S3.SS1.p1]、MSMARCO 抽象问答 [S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 以及 FEVER 事实验证 [S1.p4]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: RAG 在四个开放域问答任务上均取得新的最优结果，且无需昂贵的显著跨度掩码预训练 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: Table 2 shows that RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成中，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均优于 BART 的 Q-BLEU-1 [S4.SS3.p1]；

quote: Table 2 shows that RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 人类评估显示 RAG 比 BART 更事实（42.7% vs 7.1%）且更具体 [S4.SS3.p1]。

claim: 通过替换非参数记忆索引，RAG 可更新世界知识：使用匹配年份索引时准确率约 70% 和 68%，不匹配时仅 12% 和 4% [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者指出，在初步实验中，某些任务（如故事生成）的检索组件会“崩溃”，无论输入如何都检索相同文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward.
claim: 对于 FEVER 的证据句子抽取子任务，由于 FEVER 使用不同的 Wikipedia dump，直接处理并不简单，作者希望在未来工作中解决 [A5.p1]。

quote: MSMARCO has some questions that cannot be answered in a way that matches the reference answer without access to the gold passages, such as “What is the weather in Volcano, CA?” so performance will be lower without using gold passages.
claim: 此外，MSMARCO 中部分问题无法仅用 Wikipedia 回答，不使用金标段落时性能会较低 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：传统方法虽然架构与任务无关，但仍需要针对每个任务准备数千到数十万个样本的微调数据集 [S1.p2]。

quote: the model develops a broad set of skills and pattern recognition abilities at training time, and then uses those abilities at inference time to rapidly adapt to or recognize the desired task
claim: 作者希望探索一条途径，使语言模型在训练时获得广泛技能，并在推理时仅通过自然语言指令和少量示例快速适应或识别任务 [S1.p6]。

quote: this approach still achieves results far inferior to fine-tuning
claim: 此前这类方法的结果远逊于微调，因此需要大幅改进才能成为实用的语言任务求解方法 [S1.p7]。

quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
claim: 论文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，其规模是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍 [abstract]。

quote: we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer, similar to the Sparse Transformer
claim: 模型沿用 GPT-2 的架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式，并训练了从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿参数的 8 种不同规模模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
claim: 评估时，GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]。

quote: we evaluate each example in the evaluation set by randomly drawing $K$ examples from that task’s training set as conditioning
claim: 少样本设置从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型上下文窗口 2048 限制 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models and typically fits $10$ to $100$ examples
claim: 少样本设置从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型上下文窗口 2048 限制 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
claim: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在少样本、单样本和零样本三种条件下评估 [S1.p9]。

quote: we group the datasets into 9 categories representing roughly similar tasks
claim: 数据集被分为 9 类，涵盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及合成与定性任务 [S3.p2][S3.p3]。

quote: In Section 3.9, we invent some additional tasks designed especially to probe in-context learning abilities
claim: 数据集被分为 9 类，涵盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及合成与定性任务 [S3.p2][S3.p3]。

quote: we develop systematic tools to measure data contamination and quantify its distorting effects
claim: 此外，论文还系统研究了数据污染，开发工具测量其影响，并对部分数据集不报告结果或加星号标注 [S1.p15]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves strong performance on many NLP datasets, including translation, question-answering, and cloze tasks
claim: GPT-3 在多个 NLP 数据集上取得较强表现，包括翻译、问答和完形填空，以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务，有时甚至接近此前最先进的微调方法 [abstract]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves 86.4% accuracy in the few-shot setting, an increase of over 18% from the previous state-of-the-art
claim: 在 LAMBADA 上，GPT-3 少样本达到 86.4% 准确率，比此前最先进结果提高超过 18% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。

quote: The zero-shot result already outperforms the fine-tuned T5-11B by 14.2%
claim: 在 TriviaQA 上，零样本结果已超过微调 T5-11B 14.2%，少样本结果进一步比单样本提高 3.2% [S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3. This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
claim: 然而，GPT-3 在部分任务上仍然表现不佳，如 ANLI、RACE 和 QuAC [S1.p13]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves strong performance on many NLP datasets, including translation, question-answering, and cloze tasks
claim: 此外，GPT-3 能生成人类评估者难以与人类撰写文章区分的新闻样本 [abstract]。

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
claim: 作者指出 GPT-3 存在若干局限：模型仅采用自回归架构，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能解释其在 WiC、ANLI 及部分阅读理解任务上的落后表现 [S5.p3]。

quote: it may eventually run into (or could already be running into) the limits of the pretraining objective
claim: 另一个更根本的局限是，单纯扩大自监督预测模型可能最终触及预训练目标的极限，因为当前目标对每个 token 等权，缺乏重要性概念，且模型未扎根于视频或真实世界物理交互等其他经验领域 [S5.p4]。

quote: Another limitation broadly shared by language models is poor sample efficiency during pre-training.
claim: 此外，GPT-3 在预训练阶段的样本效率仍然较差，其预训练所见文本远多于人类一生所见 [S5.p5]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
claim: 少样本学习究竟是在推理时从零学习新任务，还是仅识别训练中已学到的任务，这一点仍不明确 [S5.p6]。

quote: they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on, which may present a challenge for practical applicability of models of this scale in their current form
claim: 最后，GPT-3 规模的模型推理成本高且不便，可能对实际应用构成挑战 [S5.p7]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中，卷积架构仍占主导，能否不依赖 CNN，而将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中，卷积架构仍占主导，能否不依赖 CNN，而将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像分类 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。

quote: Self-attention-based architectures, in particular Transformers, have become the model of choice in natural language processing (NLP).
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，作者希望以尽可能少的修改把标准 Transformer 直接用于图像 [S1.p1][S1.p3]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 其动机来自 Transformer 在 NLP 中的成功与可扩展性，作者希望以尽可能少的修改把标准 Transformer 直接用于图像 [S1.p1][S1.p3]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 方法上，作者尽量遵循原始 Transformer 的设计，将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，再把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.p1]。

quote: In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
claim: 方法上，作者尽量遵循原始 Transformer 的设计，将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，再把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.p1]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 为进行分类，作者在序列中加入一个可学习的分类 token，并将其输出作为图像表示 [S3.F1][S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 为进行分类，作者在序列中加入一个可学习的分类 token，并将其输出作为图像表示 [S3.F1][S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: As an alternative to raw image patches, the input sequence can be formed from feature maps of a CNN.
claim: 此外，作者还提出混合架构，即输入序列可以由 CNN 特征图构成 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
claim: 实验在 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）上预训练，并迁移到 ImageNet、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102 以及 19 任务的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: For the baseline CNNs, we use ResNet, but replace the Batch Normalization layers with Group Normalization
claim: 基线 CNN 使用将 Batch Normalization 替换为 Group Normalization 的 ResNet（BiT），混合模型则把中间特征图以 1 像素的 patch 送入 ViT [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: We report results on downstream datasets either through few-shot or fine-tuning accuracy.
claim: 评价指标包括微调精度和 few-shot 精度 [S4.SS1.p6]。

quote: Vision Transformer models pre-trained on the JFT-300M dataset outperform ResNet-based baselines on all datasets, while taking substantially less computational resources to pre-train.
claim: 在 JFT-300M 上预训练的 ViT 在所有数据集上优于基于 ResNet 的基线，同时预训练计算资源显著更少 [S4.T2]。

quote: the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
claim: 最佳模型在 ImageNet 上达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 上 90.72%、CIFAR-100 上 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务上 77.63% 的精度 [S1.p5]。

quote: ViT-H/14 outperforms BiT-R152x4, and other methods, on the Natural and Structured tasks.
claim: ViT-H/14 在 VTAB 的 Natural 和 Structured 任务上超过 BiT-R152x4 等方法，而在 Specialized 上前两名模型表现相近 [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: When pre-trained on the smallest dataset, ImageNet, ViT-Large models underperform compared to ViT-Base models
claim: 数据规模方面，在最小数据集 ImageNet 上 ViT-Large 不如 ViT-Base，在 ImageNet-21k 上两者相近，只有 JFT-300M 才体现出更大模型的全部优势 [S4.SS3.p2]。

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 作者指出，仍有许多挑战：一是将 ViT 应用于检测、分割等其他计算机视觉任务 [S5.p2]；

quote: One is to apply ViT to other computer vision tasks, such as detection and segmentation.
claim: 二是继续探索自监督预训练方法，初步实验显示自监督预训练有提升，但与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S5.p2]。

quote: our smaller ViT-B/16 model achieves 79.9% accuracy on ImageNet, a significant improvement of 2% to training from scratch, but still 4% behind supervised pre-training.
claim: 此外，自监督的 masked patch prediction 下 ViT-B/16 在 ImageNet 上达到 79.9%，比从头训练提升 2%，但仍落后监督预训练 4% [S4.SS6.p1]。

quote: In this paper, we explore how transformer-based language models memorize knowledge during training and extract it during inference.
claim: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型在训练中如何记忆知识、并在推理时提取知识，尤其是模型回答“林肯出生在哪个城市”这类问题时，是真正从传记等来源中提取知识，还是因为在训练中见过相似或相同的问题而记住了答案 [S1.p2][S1.p5]。

quote: leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
claim: 论文要回答的核心问题是：语言模型在训练中如何记忆知识、并在推理时提取知识，尤其是模型回答“林肯出生在哪个城市”这类问题时，是真正从传记等来源中提取知识，还是因为在训练中见过相似或相同的问题而记住了答案 [S1.p2][S1.p5]。

quote: leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
claim: 作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，难以区分这两种情况，因此需要可控实验 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

quote: Given the challenges of conducting controlled experiments with internet data, we propose studying this question using well-controlled, synthetically generated data
claim: 作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，难以区分这两种情况，因此需要可控实验 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

quote: In this paper, we introduce synthetic human biography datasets and near-real datasets generated by LLaMa.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS 和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，每个个体包含出生日期、出生城市、大学、专业、雇主、工作城市六个属性 [S2.p1][S2.p4][A1.SS1.p1]。

quote: We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS 和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，每个个体包含出生日期、出生城市、大学、专业、雇主、工作城市六个属性 [S2.p1][S2.p4][A1.SS1.p1]。

quote: Each individual’s first, middle, and last names, birth date, birth city, university attended, major of study, and current employer are selected independently and randomly from a uniform distribution.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS 和由 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR，每个个体包含出生日期、出生城市、大学、专业、雇主、工作城市六个属性 [S2.p1][S2.p4][A1.SS1.p1]。

quote: After pretraining the model on the entire biography, we fine-tune it using question and answer (QA) pairs from a $p$ fraction of individuals.
claim: 训练流程包括：在全部传记上预训练，再用一部分个体的 QA 对进行指令微调，并在未见过 QA 的剩余个体上做分布外测试 [S1.p7]。

quote: We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing).
claim: 作者还提出两种近线性探测方法——基于位置的 P-probing 和基于查询的 Q-probing，用于检查知识在隐藏状态中的编码位置 [S5.p1]。

quote: For the set of $N=100,000$ individuals, we provide an instructive prompt to Llama to generate a biographical entry.
claim: 实验使用 N=100,000 个个体的传记数据，bioS 为合成数据，bioR 由 Llama 生成 [S2.p4][A1.SS1.p1]。

quote: In the synthetic dataset labeled as bioS, we generate profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
claim: 实验使用 N=100,000 个个体的传记数据，bioS 为合成数据，bioR 由 Llama 生成 [S2.p4][A1.SS1.p1]。

quote: We use a 12-layer, 12-head, 768-dim GPT2 (124M) or Llama architecture for pre-training on the bioS data, but a larger 12-layer, 20-head, 1280-dim GPT2 (302M) or Llama for the bioR data
claim: 模型采用 GPT2/Llama 架构，bioS 使用 12 层 12 头 768 维（124M）模型，bioR 使用 12 层 20 头 1280 维（302M）模型，负结果中还尝试了 682M 模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: In mixed training, we train the model from scratch on all BIO data and half of the QA data.
claim: 混合训练中，模型从零开始在全部 BIO 数据和一半 QA 数据上训练，QA 数据比例参数 QA_r 主要设为 0.8 [S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: QA accuracy is measured by the proportion of answers that exactly match the correct response.
claim: 评估使用剩余 QA 数据，QA 准确率按答案完全匹配的比例计算 [S2.p6]。

quote: the model first uses QAs to encode knowledge about the $p$ fraction, then correlates this encoded knowledge with the biography to infer generalization to the remaining $1-p$ fraction
claim: 在混合训练中，模型先用 QA 编码 p 部分个体的知识，再与传记关联，从而泛化到剩余 1-p 部分 [S1.p8]。

quote: the model exhibits zero-zero QA accuracy on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$ for all finetuning parameters
claim: 但仅在传记上预训练再 QA 微调时，模型在测试个体上的 QA 准确率为零，即使模型规模约为 N 的 7000 倍、每个个体在预训练中暴露 1350 次 [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: Pretraining on a dataset where each person has 5 diverse biography entries (i.e., different wording, sentence shuffling) boosts the QA fine-tune accuracy (on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) from 9.7% to 96.6%.
claim: 加入知识增强后，例如每人 5 条不同措辞的传记条目，QA 微调准确率从 9.7% 提升到 96.6% [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: In the bioS single setup, P-probing accuracy remains low (e.g., 2% for company name) until the token immediately preceding the target attribute (where accuracy boosts to 100%).
claim: P-probing 显示，在 bioS single 中公司名属性在目标属性前一个 token 之前准确率仅约 2%，而在 bioS multi5+permute 中六个属性从第一个特殊位置起准确率接近 100% [S5.SS1.p4]。

quote: the model first uses QAs to encode knowledge about the $p$ fraction, then correlates this encoded knowledge with the biography to infer generalization to the remaining $1-p$ fraction
claim: 此外，仅对“名人”子集做知识增强，也能显著提升未增强“少数群体”的测试准确率 [S1.p8]。

quote: the model first uses QAs to encode knowledge about the $p$ fraction, then correlates this encoded knowledge with the biography to infer generalization to the remaining $1-p$ fraction

quote: All Bayesian inference is performed using the Metropolis-Hastings MCMC sampler in cobaya.
claim: 论文还考虑了扩展模型，允许空间曲率 ΩK、中微子质量总和 Σmν、常数暗能量状态方程参数 w 或时变参数 (w0,wa) 以及有效相对论种类数 Neff 变化 [S2.SS5.p3]。

quote: in seven redshift bins from over 6 million extragalactic objects in the redshift range 0.1 < z < 4.2

claim: 分析基于 DESI 第一年观测（DR1）数据，涵盖 0.1<z<4.2 红移范围内超过 600 万个河外天体，包括亮星系（BGS）、亮红星系（LRG）、发射线星系（ELG）、类星体（QSO）和莱曼α森林示踪物 [abstract][S2.SS2.SSS0.Px6.p2]。

quote: in seven redshift bins from over 6 million extragalactic objects in the redshift range 0.1 < z < 4.2
claim: 论文将 DESI BAO 数据与外部数据集结合，包括来自 BBN 的重子密度先验、Planck 和 ACT 的 CMB 各向异性及透镜数据，以及 Pantheon+、Union3 和 DES-SN5YR 等 Ia 型超新星数据集 [abstract][S2.SS4.SSS2.p4]。

quote: We adopt this combined CMB lensing likelihood from both experiments as our baseline.
claim: 论文将 DESI BAO 数据与外部数据集结合，包括来自 BBN 的重子密度先验、Planck 和 ACT 的 CMB 各向异性及透镜数据，以及 Pantheon+、Union3 和 DES-SN5YR 等 Ia 型超新星数据集 [abstract][S2.SS4.SSS2.p4]。

quote: DESI BAO data alone are consistent with the standard flat $\Lambda$ CDM cosmological model with a matter density $\Omega_{\mathrm{m}}=0.295\pm 0.015$
claim: DESI BAO 数据单独与平坦 ΛCDM 模型一致，给出 Ωm=0.295±0.015 [abstract]。

quote: DESI BAO data alone are consistent with the standard flat $\Lambda$ CDM cosmological model with a matter density $\Omega_{\mathrm{m}}=0.295\pm 0.015$
claim: 结合 BBN 先验和 CMB 声学角尺度，DESI 要求 H0=(68.52±0.62) km/s/Mpc [abstract]。

quote: DESI BAO data alone are consistent with the standard flat $\Lambda$ CDM cosmological model with a matter density $\Omega_{\mathrm{m}}=0.295\pm 0.015$
claim: 在常数暗能量状态方程 w 的扩展模型中，DESI BAO 单独要求 w=-0.99+0.15-0.13 [abstract]。

quote: DESI BAO data alone are consistent with the standard flat $\Lambda$ CDM cosmological model with a matter density $\Omega_{\mathrm{m}}=0.295\pm 0.015$
claim: 在时变暗能量状态方程 (w0,wa) 模型中，DESI 与 CMB 或 Ia 型超新星的组合偏好 w0>-1 和 wa<0，DESI+CMB 组合的偏好为 2.6σ，加入超新星后与 ΛCDM 的差异分别为 2.5σ、3.5σ 或 3.9σ（对应 Pantheon+、Union3 或 DES-SN5YR）[abstract]。

quote: DESI BAO data alone are consistent with the standard flat $\Lambda$ CDM cosmological model with a matter density $\Omega_{\mathrm{m}}=0.295\pm 0.015$
claim: 对于中微子质量总和自由的平坦 ΛCDM 模型，DESI 与 CMB 结合给出 Σmν<0.072 eV（95% 置信度，Σmν>0 先验）[abstract]。

quote: We however caution that this substantial tightening of the upper bound compared to the previous state-of-the-art measurements is partly driven by the preference of DESI data for a higher value of $H_{0}$.
claim: 作者指出，中微子质量上限的显著收紧部分是由 DESI 数据偏好较高 H0 值驱动的，且上限依赖于对 Σmν 所选的先验；由于 DESI 通过打破几何简并度起作用，在改变背景几何的扩展模型中该上限会放宽 [S8.p8]。

quote: However, we caution against over-interpretation of this result, since at least some of the $\left(w_{0},w_{a}\right)$ models preferred by our analysis could be mapped to quintessence models which reproduce the observable quantities $D_{M}/r_{d}$ and $D_{H}/r_{d}$ to high precision even though they do not violate the null energy condition at any redshift
claim: 作者还警告不要过度解读 (w0,wa) 结果，因为分析偏好的至少部分 (w0,wa) 模型可能映射到不违反零能量条件的精质模型，或可由修改引力或多场模型获得，是否能在分析偏好的完整 (w0,wa) 范围内找到避免幽灵区的映射仍有待探索 [S5.SS2.p9]。

quote: It remains important to thoroughly examine unaccounted-for sources of systematic uncertainties or inconsistencies between the different datasets that might be contributing to these results.
claim: 此外，作者强调需要彻底检查可能贡献于这些结果的未计入系统误差或数据集间不一致性 [S8.p7]。

quote: A guiding consideration in antibody optimization is selecting mutations that maintain the structure and therefore structure-mediated properties, such as stability and antigen binding mode.
claim: 抗体优化需要选择能维持结构和结构介导性质（如稳定性和抗原结合模式）的突变 [S1.p3]。

quote: However, the sequence recovery of existing tools for the CDR regions has been limited.
claim: 已有的抗体逆折叠工具在 CDR 区域的序列恢复率有限，且基于 ProteinMPNN 的工具存在链重排、CDRH3 第 112 位插入或向 IMGT 编号抗体引入缺口等与抗体结构不兼容的问题 [S1.p5]。

quote: Here, we present AntiFold, an antibody-specific inverse folding model fine-tuned from ESM-IF1, which significantly improves upon CDR sequence recovery and zero-shot affinity prediction.
claim: 因此本文提出抗体特异性逆折叠模型 AntiFold，以改进 CDR 序列恢复和零样本亲和力预测 [S1.p6]。

quote: AntiFold leverages ESM-IF1’s pre-training on $>$ 12M structures by fine-tuning the model further on solved and predicted antibody structures.
claim: AntiFold 在 ESM-IF1 逆折叠架构基础上，利用 ESM-IF1 在超过 1200 万个结构上的预训练，再在抗体结构上微调 [S2.SS1.p1][S0.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Fine-tuning from a general protein inverse folding model enabled us to benefit from existing knowledge learned by ESM-IF1, which was trained on millions of structures.
claim: AntiFold 在 ESM-IF1 逆折叠架构基础上，利用 ESM-IF1 在超过 1200 万个结构上的预训练，再在抗体结构上微调 [S2.SS1.p1][S0.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

quote: The inverse folding problem can be formalized as learning the conditional probability distribution, $p(Y|X)$, of the protein sequence, $Y$, consisting of amino acids $(y_{1},\ldots,y_{i},\ldots,y_{n})$, given the structure, $X$, with spatial coordinates of the backbone atoms (N, C α and C) $(x_{1},\ldots,x_{i},\ldots,x_{3n})$ (Equation (1)).
claim: 逆折叠问题被形式化为在给定主链原子坐标下学习序列的条件概率分布 p(Y|X) [S0.SS1.SSS3.p1]。

quote: Based on these results, we chose to train the final AntiFold model with IMGT-weighted shotgun and span masking, layer-wise learning rate decay and added Gaussian noise on predicted structures.
claim: 训练采用 IMGT 加权的 shotgun 与 span 掩码、逐层学习率衰减，并对预测结构加入高斯噪声 [S0.SS2.SSS1.p5]。

quote: Based on these results, we chose to train the final AntiFold model with IMGT-weighted shotgun and span masking, layer-wise learning rate decay and added Gaussian noise on predicted structures.
claim: 模型分两阶段训练：先在 OAS 预测结构训练集上微调一遍，再在已解析训练集上微调，直至验证损失连续 10 个 epoch 无改善 [S0.SS2.SSS1.p5]。

quote: To enable a direct comparison with AbMPNN, we trained, validated and tested our model on the same data: 2,074 solved complexes from the Structural Antibody Database (SAbDab), and 147,458 structures of sequences from the Observed Antibody Space (OAS) paired database modeled with ABodyBuilder2.
claim: 为与 AbMPNN 直接比较，模型在与 AbMPNN 相同的数据上训练、验证和测试：来自 SAbDab 的 2,074 个已解析复合物，以及用 ABodyBuilder2 建模的 147,458 个来自 OAS 配对数据库的序列结构，按 90% 拼接 CDR 序列一致性截断以 80/10/10 划分 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: To enable a direct comparison with AbMPNN, we trained, validated and tested our model on the same data: 2,074 solved complexes from the Structural Antibody Database (SAbDab), and 147,458 structures of sequences from the Observed Antibody Space (OAS) paired database modeled with ABodyBuilder2.
claim: 由于 IgMPNN 的模型权重和训练数据不可得，未与其直接比较 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: We assessed the ability of AntiFold and other inverse folding models to predict antibody-antigen binding affinity by applying them to a deep mutational scan of an anti-lysozyme antibody.
claim: 结合亲和力预测在抗溶菌酶抗体 Fab D44.1（PDB 1MLC）的 2209 个可变域变体深度突变扫描上评估，并以序列模型 ESM-2（650M 参数）作为基线 [S3.SS3.p1]。

quote: To further explore the ability of AntiFold to guide antibody design by predicting antibody-antigen binding affinity, we applied the model to 124 variants across 7 antibodies generated in protein language model-guided affinity maturation experiments.
claim: 此外还在 7 个抗体、124 个来自蛋白语言模型引导亲和力成熟实验的变体上进行了评估 [S3.SS3.p3]。

quote: AntiFold demonstrated a substantial improvement in AAR on the experimental structure test set as compared to the original ESM-IF1 model (60 vs 43% AAR for CDRH3, p $<$ 0.005; Table 1, Figure S2.
claim: 在实验结构测试集上，AntiFold 的氨基酸恢复率相比原始 ESM-IF1 大幅提升（CDRH3 为 60% vs 43%，p < 0.005），并在 CDRH3（60% vs 56%）、其余 CDR 区域（75-84% vs 63-76%）和多数 FR 区域（87-94% vs 85-89%）上优于 AbMPNN [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: AntiFold significantly outperformed the other models with a Spearman’s rank correlation of 0.418, versus ESM-IF1 (0.334), AbMPNN (0.322), ProteinMPNN (0.301) and ESM-2 (0.264), assessed by Mann-Whitney one-tailed U tests.
claim: 在抗溶菌酶深度突变扫描中，AntiFold 的 Spearman 秩相关为 0.418，优于 ESM-IF1（0.334）、AbMPNN（0.322）、ProteinMPNN（0.301）和 ESM-2（0.264）[S3.SS3.p1]。

quote: With this additional context, AntiFold’s performance improves in the case of all CDR regions, in particular the CDR2 ( $S_{r}$ 42.7 to 47.3%, p $<$ 0.005) and CDR3 ( $S_{r}$ 29.8 to 32.0%, p $<$ 0.005), but not for framework residues.
claim: 加入抗原链后，AntiFold 在所有 CDR 区域性能提升，尤其是 CDR2（Sr 42.7 到 47.3%，p < 0.005）和 CDR3（Sr 29.8 到 32.0%，p < 0.005），而 ProteinMPNN 和 AbMPNN 在多数 CDR 区域反而下降 [S3.SS3.p2]。

quote: AntiFold achieved significantly improved separation of these groups, scoring the improved variants with a median rank score of 80% (p $<$ 0.005) versus 73 % for ProteinMPNN, 57 % for ESM-IF1 and 55 % for AbMPNN.
claim: 在 124 个变体上，AntiFold 对改善变体的中位秩评分为 80%（p < 0.005），高于 ProteinMPNN 的 73%、ESM-IF1 的 57% 和 AbMPNN 的 55% [S3.SS3.p5]。

quote: However, the property of a potential candidate material not only depends on its chemical composition and corresponding near-equilibrium atomic structure, but also on thermodynamic conditions including temperature and pressure.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：材料性质不仅取决于化学组成和近平衡原子结构，还取决于温度和压力等热力学条件，因此需要在远超基态或局域极小值的巨大构型空间上保持高预测精度，而现有数据库和模型难以满足这一要求 [S1.p2]。

quote: We note that data in current databases has significant chemical and/or structural bias, leading to significant under-sampling of materials space.
claim: 作者指出，当前数据库存在显著的化学和/或结构偏置，导致材料空间采样不足，模型在有限温度和压力下的泛化能力与预测能力不足 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote: MatterSim employs an active learning approach to explore the extensive materials space, integrating a deep graph neural network, a materials explorer, a first-principles supervisor, and an ensemble uncertainty monitor
claim: MatterSim 采用主动学习方法探索材料空间，整合深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: MatterSim employs an active learning approach to explore the extensive materials space, integrating a deep graph neural network, a materials explorer, a first-principles supervisor, and an ensemble uncertainty monitor
claim: 第一性原理监督器在 GGA-PBE 水平（对部分材料加 Hubbard U 修正）提供能量、力和应力监督信号，训练后的模型作为第一性原理方法的代理，引导材料探索器采集更多结构并迭代扩充训练数据 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: In this work, we opt to use two primary architectures, M3GNet and Graphormer as the backbones for MatterSim.
claim: 模型骨干采用 M3GNet 和 Graphormer 两种架构，其中 M3GNet 数据效率高、推理快，Graphormer 基于 Transformer、可扩展性更强但推理更慢、显存需求更高 [S2.SS1.p3]。

quote: As of the date of publication, the training dataset contains $\sim$ 17M structures labeled with first-principles computations.
claim: 训练数据集由主动学习流程生成，截至发表时包含约 1700 万个经第一性原理标注的结构，覆盖 0–5000 K 和 0–1000 GPa 的温度压力范围 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote: The MPF-Alkali-TP, MPF-TP, Random-TP benchmark sets are created with increasing complexity to evaluate the models’ performance on materials under finite temperature and pressure conditions with far from equilibrium atomic positions.
claim: 零样本性能在多个公开数据集以及三个新建数据集（MPF-Alkali-TP、MPF-TP、Random-TP）上评测，后者由第一性原理分子动力学轨迹构建，温度在 0–5000 K 均匀采样、压力在 0–1000 GPa 对数采样 [S6.p2]。

quote: the comparison is carried out between MatterSim and a few open-source universal MLFFs, including M3GNet, CHGNet, MACE-MP-0.
claim: 对比对象包括 M3GNet、CHGNet、MACE-MP-0 等开源通用机器学习力场 [S6.p3]。

quote: MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
claim: 此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB、力学性质、自由能与相图、分子动力学鲁棒性以及 MatBench 回归任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6][S2.SS5.p2]。

quote: Fig. 4 (a) shows the benchmark results on the materials from the PhononDB, using maximum phonon frequency as an indicator, and a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$.
claim: 此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB、力学性质、自由能与相图、分子动力学鲁棒性以及 MatBench 回归任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6][S2.SS5.p2]。

quote: Fig. 4 (c) shows the parity plot of the $0\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ -bulk modulus predicted from MatterSim and their first-principles references. A remarkable agreement is achieved with an MAE of only $2.47\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.
claim: 此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB、力学性质、自由能与相图、分子动力学鲁棒性以及 MatBench 回归任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6][S2.SS5.p2]。

quote: when compared with experimental measurements on over 200 materials as shown in Fig. S22, it achieves an MAE of $15\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$
claim: 此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB、力学性质、自由能与相图、分子动力学鲁棒性以及 MatBench 回归任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6][S2.SS5.p2]。

quote: we randomly selected 118 systems including bulk inorganic materials, metal organic frameworks, two-dimensional materials, interfaces, molecular crystals, polymers and surfaces
claim: 此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB、力学性质、自由能与相图、分子动力学鲁棒性以及 MatBench 回归任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6][S2.SS5.p2]。

quote: MatterSim’s capability to directly predict materials properties from structures is benchmarked on a few regression tasks from MatBench, including prediction of computed band gaps, shear moduli, dielectric constants, max phonon frequency of bulk crystalline materials, and the exfoliation energies of two-dimensional materials.
claim: 此外还在 MatBench Discovery、PhononDB、力学性质、自由能与相图、分子动力学鲁棒性以及 MatBench 回归任务上进行了验证 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4][S2.SS2.p5][S2.SS2.p6][S2.SS5.p2]。

quote: with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 36 meV/atom (43 meV/atom as chemical accuracy) on MPF-TP
claim: 作为零样本力场，MatterSim 在 MPF-TP 数据集上的能量平均绝对误差为 36 meV/atom，相比此前最优模型精度提升十倍 [S1.p3][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: MatterSim outperforms force fields trained on open relaxation trajectory databases with a substantial increase in accuracy by an order of magnitude compared to previous best-in-class
claim: 作为零样本力场，MatterSim 在 MPF-TP 数据集上的能量平均绝对误差为 36 meV/atom，相比此前最优模型精度提升十倍 [S1.p3][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: MatterSim shows a strong capability in predicting stability of new materials, with an F1 score of 0.83 and a mean absolute energy error of the formation energy of $25\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ benchmarked on MatBench Discovery
claim: 在 MatBench Discovery 上取得 F1 分数 0.83、形成能平均绝对误差 25 meV/atom 的 SOTA 表现 [S2.SS2.p2]。

quote: a good agreement is achieved with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $0.87\text{\,}\mathrm{THz}$

quote: A remarkable agreement is achieved with an MAE of only $2.47\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.
claim: 在 PhononDB 上最大声子频率的 MAE 为 0.87 THz，0 K 体模量的 MAE 为 2.47 GPa [S2.SS2.p3][S2.SS2.p4]。

claim: 自由能预测在 1000 K 以内与 PBE 级 QHA 计算相比误差低于 10 meV/atom，与 200 多个材料的实验测量相比 MAE 为 15 meV/atom，优于专门在实验数据上训练的模型 [S2.SS2.p5]。

quote: MatterSim achieved more than 90% success rate for all the material families tested, exhibiting robustness over wide temperature ranges.
claim: 在 118 个系统的分子动力学测试中，所有材料家族的成功率超过 90%，压力测试的平均完成率也超过 90% [S2.SS2.p6]。

quote: the model reproduces similar level of accuracy for $\text{Li}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\text{B}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{12}}}\text{H}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{12}}}$, while including only 15% of the data if it were trained from scratch.
claim: 通过主动学习，仅需 15% 的数据即可在 Li2B12H12 上达到从头训练相当的精度 [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: The potency of predictions generated by the machine learning emulator is inherently constrained by the theoretical level of the training data.

quote: The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
claim: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 1200 万分子的 2.08 亿个构象和 320 万个蛋白质口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。

quote: The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
claim: 口袋条件生成任务在 CrossDocked 数据集上微调，过滤后约有 2700 万口袋-配体对，覆盖 1.4 万分子与 3000 个口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。

quote: The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
claim: 3D 分子与 3D 构象生成任务在 GEOM-DRUGS 数据集上微调，该数据集包含 30 万分子的 2700 万个构象 [S4.p2]。

quote: The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
claim: 零样本构象生成评估使用 Platinum 数据集 [S4.p2]。

quote: We use a distributed Reinforcement Learning algorithm based on the TRL training loop.
claim: 强化学习使用基于 TRL 训练循环的分布式算法，8 个 GPU worker，每个本地 batch size 为 16 [A2.SS3.p1]。

quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 预训练的 BindGPT 在无显式和有显式氢两种设置下均持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上达到 state-of-the-art [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
claim: 在 Platinum 零样本构象生成评估中，BindGPT 在 RDKit 辅助下能匹配 Torsional Diffusion 的表现，无辅助时存在小差距，而 Uni-Mol 未能泛化到该数据集 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
claim: 在口袋条件分子生成中，经强化学习微调的 BindGPT-RL 在结合能上显著优于此前所有最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful
claim: 论文旨在利用深度学习从 Kepler 光变曲线中测量恒星自转周期，以应对经典方法在大数据集上耗时、难以处理复杂光变曲线且无法提供不确定性估计的问题 [S1.p2][S1.SS1.p1]。

quote: One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions, which are essential for evaluating the reliability of the results.
claim: 论文旨在利用深度学习从 Kepler 光变曲线中测量恒星自转周期，以应对经典方法在大数据集上耗时、难以处理复杂光变曲线且无法提供不确定性估计的问题 [S1.p2][S1.SS1.p1]。

quote: The study of stellar rotation periods has become increasingly important in our understanding of stellar evolution, activity cycles, and exoplanet detection.
claim: 作者指出，恒星自转周期的研究对理解恒星演化、活动周以及系外行星探测日益重要，而空间测光任务提供了大量高精度长时标光变曲线 [S1.p1]。

quote: The model utilizes a dual-branch architecture combining Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Transformer components to capture temporal and global data features.
claim: LightPred 采用双分支架构，结合 LSTM 与 Transformer 组件以捕捉光变曲线中的时间与全局特征 [abstract][S6.p1]。

quote: By leveraging a dual-branch architecture that incorporates LSTM and Transformer components, LightPred excels at capturing both temporal dependencies and global patterns within light curves.
claim: LightPred 采用双分支架构，结合 LSTM 与 Transformer 组件以捕捉光变曲线中的时间与全局特征 [abstract][S6.p1]。

quote: First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
claim: 模型先使用 Kepler 样本进行自监督对比预训练（SSL），再以模拟光变曲线进行监督训练（SBSL）[S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy, a python package described in.
claim: 模拟数据由基于简化黑子模型的 Butterpy 生成 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: The output of the model is four numbers: rotation period, inclination, period confidence score, and inclination confidence score.
claim: 模型输出自转周期、倾角以及两者的置信度分数 [S3.SS1.p4]。

quote: This was done on a dataset of 50000 simulated samples of 1000 days that were generated as explained in II.1 and II.2.
claim: 作者在 50000 条、时长 1000 天的模拟光变曲线上训练模型，并按 81%/9%/10% 划分训练、验证与测试集 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: We compare our results to the results reported by the Tel-Aviv team in.
claim: 在模拟数据上，作者将 LightPred 与 ACF、GPS 方法以及 Tel-Aviv 团队的结果进行比较 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: This left us with 130868 which serves both for the SSL step and the inference.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，作者使用 130868 条满足 8 个连续季度的样本进行 SSL 训练与推断，并最终得到 82771 条可靠预测 [S5.SS2.p1][S5.SS3.p2]。

quote: This procedure left us with 82771 reliable predictions.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，作者使用 130868 条满足 8 个连续季度的样本进行 SSL 训练与推断，并最终得到 82771 条可靠预测 [S5.SS2.p1][S5.SS3.p2]。

quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
claim: 在模拟数据上，LightPred 在噪声与无噪声样本上均优于 Tel-Aviv 团队的结果，且比 ACF 和 GPS 更稳健；ACF 和 GPS 仅能有效预测约 85% 的数据集，而 LightPred 能预测全部样本 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
claim: 在有效预测子集上，ACF 的 acc10p 和 acc20p 与 LightPred 相当，但 LightPred 的平均误差显著更低 [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: It can be seen that in general, more confident samples have better agreement.
claim: 在 Kepler 数据上，模型学到的置信度与物理性质相关，且与三个最大目录的比较显示，不一致的点主要集中在大约半周期线和参考周期接近零的区域 [S5.SS2.SSS2.p4]。

quote: Additionally, we confirm tidal synchronization in eclipsing binaries with orbital periods shorter than 10 days.
claim: 作者还确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星中的潮汐同步现象 [abstract]。

quote: The suggested model implies an inherent degeneracy between inclination and spot location.
claim: 作者指出，模拟所基于的黑子模型存在倾角与黑子位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验，黑子分布对结果影响很大 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: We acknowledge that shuffling quarters (90 Days) might remove phase information and potentially hinder the detection of long periods.
claim: 作者承认，打乱季度（90 天）的增强可能移除相位信息并潜在地妨碍长周期探测 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: It is possible that the observed light curve does not represent a single object but multiple objects.
claim: 此外，拥挤和双星可能使观测光变曲线不代表单一目标，从而对预测产生偏差 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p1]。

quote: including the development of improved spot models for simulation data, particularly to account for the behavior of fast-rotating young stars.
claim: 作者还指出，未来需要改进模拟中的黑子模型，特别是考虑快速自转年轻恒星的行为 [S6.p5]。

quote: Their unique v-shape spectral feature characterized by a red optical continuum and a UV excess in the rest frame challenges us to discern the relative contributions of the galaxy and AGN.
claim: 论文要解决的核心问题是：LRD 的 v 形光谱特征（静止系紫外过剩与红色光学连续谱）究竟来自星系还是 AGN，以及其红外 SED 为何与典型热尘埃环模型预期不符 [abstract][S1.p3]。

quote: Those observations appear to contradict expectations that the SED should be very red throughout the optical to NIR spectrum due to re-emission from hot dust components heated by the AGNs.
claim: 论文要解决的核心问题是：LRD 的 v 形光谱特征（静止系紫外过剩与红色光学连续谱）究竟来自星系还是 AGN，以及其红外 SED 为何与典型热尘埃环模型预期不符 [abstract][S1.p3]。

quote: Those observations appear to contradict expectations that the SED should be very red throughout the optical to NIR spectrum due to re-emission from hot dust components heated by the AGNs.
claim: 作者指出，多数 LRD 在 JWST/MIRI F1800W 波段未被探测到，即使被探测到，其 MIRI SED 从静止系光学到近红外也趋于平坦，这与尘埃遮蔽 AGN 应呈现极红 SED 的预期相矛盾 [S1.p3]。

quote: the BH-to-galaxy mass ratio in LRDs is substantially higher than the empirical value observed in the nearby universe.
claim: 此外，LRD 极为致密，其黑洞与星系质量比远高于近邻宇宙的经验值，暗示存在一个正在快速增长的黑洞阶段 [S1.p4]。

quote: We hypothesize that the incident radiation from an AGN, characterized by a typical SED, is embedded in an extended dusty medium with an extinction law similar to those seen in dense regions such as Orion Nebula or certain AGN environments.
claim: 作者提出一个从静止系紫外到红外波段的 LRD SED 模型，假设一个具有典型 SED 的 AGN 入射辐射被嵌入延展尘埃介质中，其消光律类似于猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境中的致密区域 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。

quote: The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$, due to the absence of small-size grains.
claim: 作者提出一个从静止系紫外到红外波段的 LRD SED 模型，假设一个具有典型 SED 的 AGN 入射辐射被嵌入延展尘埃介质中，其消光律类似于猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境中的致密区域 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。

quote: The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$, due to the absence of small-size grains.
claim: 紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，采用 A_V≈3 mag，在 λ>4000 Å 呈现红色光学连续谱，在 λ<3000 Å 通过灰消光曲线形成平坦紫外谱形，原因是缺少小尺寸尘埃颗粒 [S5.p2]。

quote: The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$, due to the absence of small-size grains.
claim: 红外部分由延展的尘埃和气体分布（γ<1；ρ∝r^{-γ}）塑造，尘埃升华半径处特征气体密度约为 10–10^3 cm^-3，使较冷的尘埃温度主导辐射，从而将能量峰值从近红外移到中红外波段 [S5.p2]。

quote: The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$, due to the absence of small-size grains.
claim: 该模型无需额外引入恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S5.p2]。

quote: we assume a visual extinction $A_{\mathrm{V}}=3$ mag and normalize the attenuated fluxes at $\lambda=4000~{\rm\AA}$.
claim: 作者将模型与 LRD 的观测数据进行比较：在静止系紫外/光学部分，叠加了 z~5.5 和 z=7.5 的 LRD 样本堆叠光度 SED 数据，并假设 A_V=3 mag、在 λ=4000 Å 归一化 [S2.p5]。

quote: The application of the extinction law derived from AGN composite spectra was tested on a LRD (ID: J0647-1045) identified at $z=4.5321$ by JWST NIRSpec.
claim: 模型还针对 JWST NIRSpec 在 z=4.5321 确认的 LRD（ID: J0647-1045）测试了由 AGN 复合谱导出的消光律 [S2.p6]。

quote: we assume a bolometric luminosity of $L_{\rm bol}=10^{46}~{\rm erg~s}^{-1}$ as the incident radiation from the AGN, and calculate the monochromatic luminosity at rest-frame $1450~{\rm\AA}$ using a bolometric correction factor of $f_{\rm bol,UV}=4.4$.
claim: 在红外部分，模型计算了 z=4 到 z=7 的 SED，假设 AGN 入射辐射的 bolometric luminosity 为 L_bol=10^46 erg s^-1，并采用 f_bol,UV=4.4 计算静止系 1450 Å 的单色光度 [S2.p9]。

quote: Employing the criterion of $\beta_{\rm opt/NIR}=-1$, the parameter space is divided into two regions.
claim: 作者还考察了不同 n_0 与 γ 组合下的 SED 性质，并用 β_opt/NIR=-1 作为判据划分参数空间 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: Models with extinction laws observed in the Orion Nebula and AGN composite spectra flatten the SED with a UV slope of $\beta_{\rm UV}\sim-2$.
claim: 模型表明，猎户座星云和 AGN 复合谱的消光律可将 SED 压平至紫外斜率 β_UV~-2，而其他模型则导致强烈衰减、无法维持紫外过剩 [S2.p5]。

quote: such gray extinction curves can explain the characteristic v-shaped SEDs of LRDs, as evidenced by accumulated large samples, without considering multiple components such as host galaxies or scattered AGN light.
claim: 灰消光曲线能够解释 LRD 特征的 v 形 SED，无需引入宿主星系或散射 AGN 光等多成分 [S2.p6]。

quote: This model, unlike the typical AGN hot torus models, can produce a infrared SED flattening that is consistent with LRD observations through JWST MIRI.
claim: 在红外部分，与典型 AGN 热尘埃环模型不同，该模型能产生与 JWST MIRI 观测一致的 SED 平坦化 [S5.p2]。

quote: In the high density region ( $n_{0}\gtrsim 10^{3}~{\rm cm}^{-3}$), the NIR SED is influenced by re-emission from hot dust grains heated by the AGN, resulting in a steeper optical-to-NIR slope that is inconsistent with the observational requirement.
claim: 参数分析显示，高密度区（n_0≳10^3 cm^-3）的近红外 SED 受热尘埃再发射影响，光学到近红外斜率过陡，与观测要求不符 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: if stellar light accounted for the continuum flux across the entire optical band, the required stellar mass would approach $M_{\star}\gtrsim 10^{11}~M_{\odot}$, comparable to that of the Milky Way.
claim: 作者还指出，若恒星贡献主导 LRD 连续谱，所需恒星质量将接近 M_⋆≳10^11 M_⊙，与标准宇宙学框架矛盾 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: There is no clear answer to this question at this time, but some speculations are given below.
claim: 作者明确指出，LRD 为何在 z>4 出现且具有统一的 A_V=3 mag 消光水平，目前尚无明确答案，只能给出一些推测 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: we assume a full-sky covering case (i.e., $C\equiv\Omega/4\pi=1$), while this value will be determined when the relative cosmic abundance between LRDs and unobscured AGNs and the dependence of $C$ on the AGN properties such as the Eddington ratio are better understood for LRDs.
claim: 模型中假设全天覆盖（C≡Ω/4π=1），该值需在 LRD 与未遮蔽 AGN 的相对宇宙丰度以及 C 对 AGN 性质（如 Eddington 比）的依赖被更好理解后才能确定 [S3.p4]。

quote: the F1800W upper limit is derived from stacking images covering less than 20% of the LRD samples observed with the F770W MIRI filter.
claim: 此外，F1800W 上限来自覆盖不到 20% 的 LRD 样本的堆叠图像 [S3.p9]。

quote: A more detailed quantitative analysis of this scenario will be explored in future work.
claim: 关于尘埃散射导致变异性衰减的定量分析，作者表示将在未来工作中进一步探索 [S4.SS3.p2]。

quote: In this paper, we present a new set of foundation models for language, called Llama 3.
claim: 论文旨在提出一套新的语言基础模型 Llama 3，其原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: Compared to prior versions of Llama, we improved both the quantity and quality of the data we use for pre-training and post-training.
claim: 研究动机在于通过改进数据数量与质量、扩大训练规模以及管理复杂性来提升模型能力 [S1.p5]。

quote: We shared the details of our development process because we believe this will: (1) help the larger research community understand the key factors of foundation model development
claim: 作者认为分享开发过程有助于研究社区理解基础模型开发的关键因素，并促进公众对基础模型未来的知情讨论 [S10.p3]。

quote: Llama 3 uses a standard, dense Transformer architecture.
claim: Llama 3 采用标准的稠密 Transformer 架构，与 Llama 和 Llama 2 相比架构变化不大，性能提升主要来自数据质量与多样性以及训练规模的增加 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: We use grouped query attention (GQA;) with 8 key-value heads to improve inference speed
claim: 相比 Llama 2 的小改动包括使用 8 个键值头的分组查询注意力、文档间自注意力掩码、128K tokens 词表和将 RoPE 基频提高到 500,000 [S3.SS2.p2]。

quote: we adopt a relatively simple post-training procedure based on supervised finetuning (SFT), rejection sampling (RS), and direct preference optimization (DPO;)
claim: 后训练采用基于监督微调、拒绝采样和直接偏好优化的相对简单流程，而非更复杂的强化学习算法 [S1.p5]。

quote: We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.
claim: 论文还通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中 [S2.p4]。

quote: These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
claim: 论文在大量标准基准上评估了预训练和后训练的 Llama 3，覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估和综合评估等类别 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: We evaluate the quality of our models on standard benchmarks (Section 5.1.1), for robustness to changes in multiple-choice question setups (Section 5.1.2), and on adversarial evaluations (Section 5.1.3).
claim: 评估还包括对多选题设置变化的鲁棒性测试和污染分析 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: In addition, we perform extensive human evaluations that compare Llama 3 with competing models.
claim: 此外，论文进行了广泛的人类评估，将 Llama 3 与竞争模型进行比较 [S1.p6]。

quote: We evaluate the performance of the image understanding capabilities of Llama 3 on a range of tasks spanning natural image understanding, text understanding, charts understanding and multimodal reasoning
claim: 多模态实验方面，视觉识别在 MMMU、VQAv2、AI2 Diagram、ChartQA、TextVQA 和 DocVQA 等基准上评估 [S7.SS6.p1]，视频识别在 PerceptionTest、NExT-QA、TVQA 和 ActivityNet-QA 上评估 [S7.SS7.p1]，语音理解在 MLS、LibriSpeech、VoxPopuli、FLEURS 和 Covost 2 上评估 [S8.SS4.p2][S8.SS4.p4]。

quote: We evaluate our video adapter for Llama 3 on three benchmarks
claim: 多模态实验方面，视觉识别在 MMMU、VQAv2、AI2 Diagram、ChartQA、TextVQA 和 DocVQA 等基准上评估 [S7.SS6.p1]，视频识别在 PerceptionTest、NExT-QA、TVQA 和 ActivityNet-QA 上评估 [S7.SS7.p1]，语音理解在 MLS、LibriSpeech、VoxPopuli、FLEURS 和 Covost 2 上评估 [S8.SS4.p2][S8.SS4.p4]。

quote: We evaluate the ASR performance on the English datasets of Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS;), LibriSpeech, VoxPopuli, and a subset of the multilingual FLEURS dataset.
claim: 多模态实验方面，视觉识别在 MMMU、VQAv2、AI2 Diagram、ChartQA、TextVQA 和 DocVQA 等基准上评估 [S7.SS6.p1]，视频识别在 PerceptionTest、NExT-QA、TVQA 和 ActivityNet-QA 上评估 [S7.SS7.p1]，语音理解在 MLS、LibriSpeech、VoxPopuli、FLEURS 和 Covost 2 上评估 [S8.SS4.p2][S8.SS4.p4]。

quote: We use the FLEURS and Covost 2 datasets in these evaluations, measuring BLEU scores of the translated English.
claim: 多模态实验方面，视觉识别在 MMMU、VQAv2、AI2 Diagram、ChartQA、TextVQA 和 DocVQA 等基准上评估 [S7.SS6.p1]，视频识别在 PerceptionTest、NExT-QA、TVQA 和 ActivityNet-QA 上评估 [S7.SS7.p1]，语音理解在 MLS、LibriSpeech、VoxPopuli、FLEURS 和 Covost 2 上评估 [S8.SS4.p2][S8.SS4.p4]。

quote: for activations, we group and scale elements on a 1x128 tile basis (i.e., per token per 128 channels)
claim: 训练方面，提出 FP8 混合精度框架，采用细粒度量化（激活按 1x128 tile、权重按 128x128 block 分组缩放）和提升累积精度等策略 [S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.Px1.p1]。

quote: the relative loss error of our FP8-training model remains consistently below 0.25%

quote: DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training.
claim: 完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时，训练过程稳定，未出现不可恢复的损失尖峰或回滚 [abstract]。

quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.

quote: it is merely a compromise due to the Hopper architecture’s hardware deficiency in FP8 GEMM accumulation precision.
claim: Hopper 架构 FP8 GEMM 累积精度有限，当前实现仅通过 CUDA 核心 FP32 累积部分缓解，是硬件缺陷下的妥协 [S3.SS5.SSS2.Px1.p1]。

quote: Current GPUs only support per-tensor quantization, lacking the native support for fine-grained quantization like our tile- and block-wise quantization.

quote: we aim to explore the potential of LLMs for developing reasoning abilities through self-evolution in an RL framework, with minimal reliance on human labeling efforts
claim: 论文旨在探索大语言模型能否通过强化学习自我演化出推理能力，从而最小化对人类标注的依赖 [S1.p2]。

quote: Their dependence on human-annotated reasoning traces hinders scalability and introduces cognitive biases
claim: 现有方法依赖人工标注的推理轨迹，限制了可扩展性并引入认知偏差，且模型性能受限于人类示例，无法探索更优的非人类推理路径 [S1.p1]。

quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework
claim: 论文基于 DeepSeek-V3-Base，采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 作为强化学习框架，奖励信号仅基于最终预测与标准答案的正确性，不约束推理过程 [S1.p2]。

quote: we build upon DeepSeek-V3-Base and employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as our RL framework
claim: 作者跳过传统的监督微调阶段，直接进行 RL 训练，以激励新颖推理能力的涌现 [S1.p2]。

quote: we introduce DeepSeek-R1, a model trained through a multi-stage learning framework that integrates rejection sampling, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning
claim: 对于 DeepSeek-R1，则采用多阶段学习框架，整合拒绝采样、强化学习和监督微调 [S1.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our models on MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, and CMMLU, IFEval, FRAMES, GPQA Diamond, SimpleQA, C-SimpleQA, SWE-Bench Verified, Aider, LiveCodeBench (2024-08 – 2025-01), Codeforces, Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad (CNMO 2024), and American Invitational Mathematics Examination 2024 (AIME 2024)
claim: 论文在多个基准上评估模型，包括 MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、IFEval、FRAMES、GPQA Diamond、SimpleQA、C-SimpleQA、SWE-Bench Verified、Aider、LiveCodeBench、Codeforces、CNMO 2024 和 AIME 2024 [S4.p1]。

claim: 训练使用 64*8 H800 GPU，DeepSeek-R1-Zero 训练约 198 小时，DeepSeek-R1 约 80 小时 [A2.SS4.SSS4.p1]。

claim: DeepSeek-R1-Zero 在 AIME 2024 上的 pass@1 从初始 15.6% 提升至 77.9%，使用自一致性解码可达 86.7% [S2.SS3.p2]。

claim: 模型在训练中自然学会增加思考时间，并涌现出反思、验证等高级推理行为 [S2.SS3.p4][S2.SS3.p5]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero increasingly exhibits advanced reasoning strategies such as reflective reasoning and systematic exploration of alternative solutions
claim: 模型在训练中自然学会增加思考时间，并涌现出反思、验证等高级推理行为 [S2.SS3.p4][S2.SS3.p5]。

claim: DeepSeek-R1 在数学任务上与 OpenAI-o1-1217 表现相当，在编程算法任务上超越其他模型 [A4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p3]。

quote: with AlpacaEval 2.0 improving by 25% and ArenaHard by 17%
claim: 最终 DeepSeek-R1 在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上提升 25%，ArenaHard 提升 17% [S4.p3]。

claim: 在 token 效率方面，对简单问题仍存在过度推理（overthinking）现象 [S6.p4]。

claim: 模型目前针对中英文优化，处理其他语言时可能出现语言混杂 [S6.p5]。

claim: 纯 RL 方法本身面临奖励黑客挑战，对于无法通过可靠奖励模型有效评估的复杂任务，扩展纯 RL 仍是开放问题 [S6.p9]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 其动机在于测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证有效，但已有复现依赖大规模强化学习或大量数据 [S1.p1]。

quote: We show that training on only 1,000 samples with next-token prediction and controlling thinking duration via a simple test-time technique we refer to as budget forcing leads to a strong reasoning model
claim: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是构建 s1K 数据集，即 1,000 个经过难度、多样性、质量三原则筛选的问题及推理轨迹，并对现成预训练模型做监督微调 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
claim: 论文提出两个简单方法：一是构建 s1K 数据集，即 1,000 个经过难度、多样性、质量三原则筛选的问题及推理轨迹，并对现成预训练模型做监督微调 [S1.p2][S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
claim: 二是 budget forcing，一种解码时干预：超过上限时追加思考结束符提前结束思考，想增加计算时抑制结束符并追加“Wait”以鼓励更多探索 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We classify test-time scaling methods into 1) Sequential, where later computations depend on earlier ones
claim: 作者将测试时扩展方法分为顺序式与并行式，并聚焦顺序式扩展 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
claim: 论文在三个推理基准上评估：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），默认温度 0、贪心解码、测准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series, closed-source models that popularized test-time scaling; DeepSeek r1 series
claim: 对比模型包括 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: We conduct extensive ablation experiments targeting (a) our selection of 1,000 (1K) reasoning samples and (b) our test-time scaling.
claim: 作者还做了数据选择消融和测试时扩展方法消融，并用 Control、Scaling、Performance 三个指标衡量扩展方法 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: We measure three metrics: Control, Scaling, and Performance
claim: 作者还做了数据选择消融和测试时扩展方法消融，并用 Control、Scaling、Performance 三个指标衡量扩展方法 [S1.p3][S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: 用 budget forcing 扩展 s1-32B 可将其在 AIME24 上的表现从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。

quote: Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
claim: 测试时扩展方面，budget forcing 具有完美可控性和清晰正斜率，扩展效果最好 [S1.p3]；

claim: 在基础模型上用多数投票做并行扩展无法追上 s1-32B [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.

quote: For AIME24, LIMO achieves 63.3% accuracy, outperforming QwQ-32B-Preview (50.0%) and OpenAI-o1-preview (44.6%) by significant margins.
claim: 域内任务上 LIMO 在所有基准取得最佳结果：AIME24 达 63.3%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 50.0% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 44.6%；MATH500 达 95.6%，超过 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 89.8% 和 OpenAI-o1-preview 的 85.5%；AMC23 达 96.3%，高于 QwQ-32B-Preview 的 83.6% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: NuminaMath-100k shows significant degradation (32.3% vs. base model’s 49.9%) due to uncurated reasoning chains, while OpenThoughts-114k achieves suboptimal results (58.3%)
claim: 与更大数据集相比，NuminaMath-100k 出现明显退化（32.3% vs 基座模型的 49.9%），OpenThoughts-114k 为 58.3%，而 LIMO 的 800 题达到 78.1% [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: modifying problem selection alone leads to 16% accuracy improvement on AIME2024, reaching 51.5%.
claim: 消融显示：仅改变题目难度即可在 AIME2024 上带来 16% 提升至 51.5%，且仅在 Advanced-500 上微调的模型在 MATH500 上达 91.2% [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；

quote: LIMO (built on Qwen2.5) achieves 63.3% accuracy on AIME2024, a 54.1 percentage point improvement over Qwen1.5’s 9.2%.
claim: 基础模型选择影响巨大，LIMO（基于 Qwen2.5）在 AIME2024 上比 Qwen1.5 的 9.2% 高出 54.1 个百分点，在 MATH500 上高出 30.4 个百分点 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p2]；

quote: The performance on AIME24 shows a marked increase with model size, rising from 2.5 for the 3B model to 68.3 for the 72B model.
claim: 模型规模上 AIME24 从 3B 的 2.5 升至 72B 的 68.3，但 32B 与 72B 在 MATH500 上差距很小（95.6% vs 94.8%）[S6.SS3.SSS4.p1]；

quote: Fine-tuning with just 400 samples yields dramatic improvement over the base model, increasing AIME24 accuracy from 16.5 to 57.5 and MATH500 accuracy from 79.4 to 94.8.
claim: 数据量上仅 400 样本即将 AIME24 从 16.5 提升到 57.5、MATH500 从 79.4 提升到 94.8，超过 800 样本后收益递减 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: we observe diminishing returns beyond 800 samples, with only marginal increases between LIMO-800 and LIMO-1k2 (+0.9 on AIME24, -0.2 on MATH500), suggesting an early plateau effect.
claim: 作者在样本效率分析中指出，超过 800 样本后出现收益递减，2k 数据集虽整体最佳但相对 1.6k 提升极小，说明超过某一阈值后额外数据对微调增益贡献较小 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: we observe diminishing returns beyond 800 samples, with only marginal increases between LIMO-800 and LIMO-1k2 (+0.9 on AIME24, -0.2 on MATH500), suggesting an early plateau effect.
claim: 作者提出未来工作可探索主动学习策略以进一步优化样本效率 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
claim: 论文指出，当前视觉语言模型面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知不足以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。

quote: we are committed to exploring fine-grained perception capabilities, aiming to establish a robust foundation for LVLMs and create an agentic amplifier for real-world applications.
claim: 为此，Qwen2.5-VL 致力于探索细粒度感知能力，为 LVLMs 建立坚实基础，并打造面向真实应用的智能体放大器 [S1.p1]。

quote: We implement window attention in the visual encoder to optimize inference efficiency
claim: Qwen2.5-VL 在视觉编码器中引入窗口注意力以优化推理效率，并引入动态 FPS 采样将动态分辨率扩展到时间维度 [S1.p4]。

quote: aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time
claim: 模型将 MRoPE 的时间分量与绝对时间对齐，使模型能在不同 FPS 采样率的视频间学习一致的时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

quote: we first group spatially adjacent sets of four patch features.
claim: 此外，模型采用基于 MLP 的视觉-语言合并器，将空间相邻的四组 patch 特征拼接后经两层 MLP 投影到与文本嵌入对齐的维度 [S2.SS1.p4]。

claim: 实验将 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 以及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等模型进行对比 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
claim: 在大学水平问题上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上取得 70.2 分，在 MMMU-Pro 上取得 51.1 分，超过此前开源最优模型并与 GPT-4o 相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。
